caption: The drawing shows a tall, ornate cabinet with a hutch atop four slender, turned legs. The overall color palette consists of varying shades of brown and beige. The cabinet has an upper section with two glass-fronted doors, displaying shelves containing items such as vertically-striped flags and small architectural models including churches with steeples. The interior back panels behind the shelves depict scenes with buildings, trees, and a cloudy sky, rendered in soft, muted tones of brown. The cabinet's frame is richly decorated with borders featuring a repeated leaf motif, star emblems at the top corners, and geometric banding in lighter and darker browns. The top of the cabinet is arched with a shield-like panel in the center flanked by two smaller peaks. The lower section, which serves as a table base, is ornamented with repeating triangular and leaf patterns running along the apron. The drawing is executed in a style that emphasizes intricate inlay-like details, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner. The image background is plain and off-white, making the furniture the focus of the composition.
title: Whalebone Cabinet
